settings.label: Games folder
settings.help: Scanned one level deep: each subfolder here is treated as one game, and its most likely .exe is launched.

settings.label: Games folder 2 (optional)
settings.help: A second games folder -- for example on another disk. Scanned the same way as the first.

settings.label: Games folder 3 (optional)
settings.help: A third games folder, scanned the same way as the first.

settings.label: Games folder 4 (optional)
settings.help: A fourth games folder, scanned the same way as the first.

settings.label: Ignore folders containing
settings.help: Semicolon-separated, case-insensitive substrings of folder names to skip entirely (defaults to common redistributable/installer folder names). Applies across every configured games folder.

settings.label: Hidden folders
settings.help: Semicolon-separated exact folder names to exclude from the library. Applies across every configured games folder.

settings.label: Executable overrides
settings.help: Semicolon-separated FolderName=relative/path/to/game.exe overrides for folders where the wrong executable was picked. Applies across every configured games folder.
